description: Ghana - SNV Energy Baseline Survey Data for Central Gonja is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Surveys", published or maintained by SNV Ghana (World Bank Group). NewEnergy in partnership with SNV conducted a survey to collect baseline data about the energy situation in Central Gonja District in April-June 2012. This exercise is part of a renewable energy project initiated by SNV in a number of districts in the three Northern Regions. Coverage: Ghana. It has 3 files in ZIP, CSV. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Surveys. The portal gives 2012 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
